ônibus.consejo: You know that: in Brazil it is used a lot.

estou a fazer.consejo: A very used form in Portugal.

dou-te.consejo: The name behind the verb, in Portugal.

texto: In Portugal it is said **autocarro** (bus) and in Brazil **ônibus**. **Comboio** (train) in Portugal and **trem** in Brazil **Pequeno-almoço** (breakfast) in Portugal and **café da manhã** in Brazil **Frigorífico** in Portugal, **geladeira** in Brazil. **Telemóvel** in Portugal, **celular** in Brazil.

As a general trend, in Portugal a lot of **estou a fazer** is used and in Brazil **estou fazendo**. In European Portuguese, it is common to enlist in simple affirmative phrases (**dou-te**), but the elements that attract pronoun cause proclysis; in Brazil, proclysis is very common in speech.
**Tu** and **você** depend on the region, the relationship between speakers and registration; they are not an absolute division between countries.

frases.pt: Em Portugal apanho o autocarro, mas no Brasil uso o ônibus.
frases.es: En Portugal cojo el autobús, pero en Brasil uso el autobús.
frases.en: In Portugal I take the bus, but in Brazil I use the bus.

frases.pt: E eu tomo o pequeno-almoço às oito.
frases.es: Y yo tomo el desayuno a las ocho.

frases.pt: Estou a fazer uma lista do que preciso.
frases.es: Estoy haciendo una lista de lo que necesito.
frases.en: I'm making a list of what I need.

frases.pt: Eu dou-te o telemóvel, se precisares.
frases.es: Te doy el móvil, si lo necesitas.
frases.en: I'll give you the phone, if you need it.
